title: This Tiny Drone Is a Beginner's Dream—And It's $30 Off Right Now!
summary: Have you ever wanted to fly a drone but worried it would be too hard? Meet the DJI Neo—a pocket-sized flying camera that's so easy, it almost flies itself! Weighing just 135 grams (that's less than a hamster!), you don't even need to register it with the government. Right now, it's on sale for $169, which is $30 off the usual price. Our drone expert James Abbott gave it four stars, calling it "incredibly easy to use and fun." You control it with an app on your phone, and it can do cool tricks like follow you around or fly in patterns all by itself. It shoots video in super-sharp 4K and takes 12-megapixel photos from the sky. The battery lasts about 18 minutes, which is plenty of time to film your neighborhood or a park. One thing to know: it doesn't have a memory card slot, so you can't store hours of video. But for quick flights and awesome shots, it's perfect. The DJI Neo is a steal at this price, especially with Amazon Prime Day starting tomorrow. If you've been curious about drones, this is your chance to grab a beginner-friendly model that punches way above its price tag. Just imagine the epic bird's-eye views you'll capture!
why_it_matters: This drone makes it possible for kids your age to safely learn about technology, photography, and even basic flying rules, all while having fun filming from the sky.

Amazon Prime Day is a yearly online sale where items like drones often get big discounts for a short time.
In the United States, you don’t need to register drones weighing less than 250 grams, so the Neo is extra easy to start with right away.

perspectives.description: The low price and easy controls mean almost anyone can start flying and recording cool aerial videos without weeks of practice.
Some might miss having a memory card slot for longer flights and want more flight time than 18 minutes.
Drones like the Neo show how fast small, helpful robots are improving — soon they could be everywhere, doing simple jobs for us.
